DharmaNexus additionally aligns passage §2.1 with the Chinese *Madhyama-āgama* (*Zhong ahan jing*, T 26, fascicle 59) [DharmaNexus]. Within Pali literature, DharmaNexus computes 22 matching passages shared across six texts [DharmaNexus]. It shares substantial phrasing with the immediately following *Milindapañha* discourse, the *Dvinnaṁlokuppannānaṁsamakabhāvapañha* (Mil 3.7.5, §3.2–3.6 ↔ §2.2–2.6) [DharmaNexus]. Furthermore, formulaic passages in §2.1–2.3 are shared with canonical discourses including the *Brahma Saṁyutta* (SN 6, §2.2–2.3 ↔ §5.2.4), the *Chakkanipāta* of the *Aṅguttara Nikāya* (AN 6, §2.2–2.3 ↔ §34.2.1), the *Mahāpadāna Sutta* (DN 14, §2.2–2.3 ↔ §3.2.13_0–3.2.13_1), the *Brahmanimantanika Sutta* (MN 49, §2.1–2.3 ↔ §3.2), and the commentary to the Jātakas (*Jātaka-aṭṭhakathā*) [DharmaNexus].
